metadata.description: A collection of Claude Code plugins for software engineering workflows.

plugins.name: dev
plugins.description: AI-DLC workflow for Claude Code: an adaptive Plan → Build → Ship pipeline with checkpoints, artifact hand-offs and review agents.

plugins.name: nextjs
plugins.description: Next.js 14+ patterns for App Router, Server Components, Server Actions, data fetching, and performance.

plugins.name: tauri
plugins.description: Tauri 2 patterns for cross-platform desktop and mobile apps: project setup, Rust IPC commands, capability-based security, plugins, auto-update and distribution.

plugins.description: Progressive Web App patterns: manifest and install, service worker lifecycle and updates, offline storage, push, deploy headers and Mobile Safari quirks.
